constraints: Official ChatGPT authentication in isolated runtime only
PostgreSQL owns policy and receipts; Temporal owns command processing
No silent model/account/API fallback; existing frozen requests are immutable
Company repository only; no research repository writes
decisionGates: Implementation authorized by user: 그래 진행해줘.

deliverables.description: Owner-controlled Codex model assignment and task override
acceptance: Authenticated model-free Slack commands for catalog, assignments, pin/reset, history and rollback
Explicit per-task model and effort override persists through subsequent turns and web calls
New requests use shared PostgreSQL policy; frozen requests and session continuations retain original settings
Real disposable PostgreSQL and Temporal integration checks; simulated Slack and model output labeled
Catalog validation rejects unavailable models, invalid efforts and stale account selection
Runbook, ADR, evidence and qws status in company repository

nonGoals: Automatic model ranking and recurring upgrade evaluation in this first slice
Live deployment, Slack sending, training, backtests and trades
Changing the independent Claude review runtime
outcome: 직원별 모델 배정을 중앙에서 관리하고 사용자 요청으로 변경한다. 특정 모델과 추론 강도의 직원별 고정, 이번 작업 한정 지정, 현황·변경 이력·복원을 구현한다. 직접 지정이 기본 배정보다 우선하며 사용할 수 없는 모델은 임의 대체하지 않는다. 사용자 승인: 그래 진행해줘.
